name: Morphological Dilation via Bit-Parallel Leaf Influence
definition: A technique to expand the topology of a sparse grid by determining which leaf nodes must be materialized based on the active voxels within existing leaves, using bitwise operations on packed occupancy masks to avoid expensive tree traversals.
summary: Morphological Dilation via Bit-Parallel Leaf Influence expands sparse voxel grid topology using bitwise operations on leaf occupancy masks to decouple topological expansion from voxel population, minimizing global memory contention.
